recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, uniform matte black square field featuring a small, high-contrast white rectangular advisory label in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme negative space dominating 98% of the composition
Small-scale graphic anchor in the bottom right quadrant
High-contrast relationship between deep black and pure white
coreInvariants: Uniform black background without texture or gradient
Bottom-right placement of the secondary graphic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is the void itself; the secondary graphic is scaled to approximately 1/15th of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye scans the vast black space before settling on the small, high-contrast detail in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Absolute and dominant, used to create a sense of mystery or finality.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the small graphic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the background and the small anchor.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales or weights within the graphic box.

avoid: Centered text in the middle of the black field

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, industrial look suitable for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, uniform matte black square with no texture, noise, or lighting effects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small white rectangular box in the bottom right corner. Inside the box, add three rows of condensed sans-serif uppercase text separated by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the graphic element only in the bottom right?

adjustableVariables: Specific text content within the graphic box
mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand-protected marks
Exact wording of the advisory label

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on the graphic element

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no compression artifacts are visible in the black field.
Verify the white box is perfectly rectangular.
Check that the text is legible despite its small scale.
Confirm the absence of any other visual elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black field + high-contrast bottom-right metadata anchor = Minimalist Void Aesthetic.
